title: Dimension of a possibly disconnected curve under field extension
statement: Let k and k' be algebraically closed fields with a k-algebra structure on k' [def-pc-field-extension], and let f : C → Spec(k) be a curve [def-sc-curves]. Then the topological Krull dimension of C ×[Spec(k)] Spec(k') [def-pc-base-change] equals that of C, including the empty scheme (dimension bottom), zero-dimensional curves, and disconnected curves.

proof.text: Let p be the first projection. If C is empty, so is its pullback, since p maps into C; both dimensions are bottom. Otherwise Spec(k') → Spec(k) is surjective (nonempty source, one-point target), and its base change p is surjective, hence the pullback is nonempty. Surjectivity stability is available directly in Mathlib.

Choose affine opens U_i = Spec(A_i) covering C. The finite type curve structure implies each A_i is a finite type k-algebra. Restricting the pullback to U_i gives the open p⁻¹(U_i), isomorphic to Spec(A_i tensor_k k'); these opens cover the pullback.

The first clause of AlgebraicGeometry.dim_base_change says ringKrullDim(A_i tensor_k k') = ringKrullDim(A_i) for every chart (Stacks 00P3). Apply Scheme.dim_eq_iSup_ringKrullDim_of_affineOpenCover to C and its nonempty pullback. Equality of the chart dimensions yields equality of their suprema. Scheme.dim_eq_topologicalKrullDim then identifies these with the topological dimensions in the statement.

proof_origin.place: Dimension paragraph, reduction to affine scalar extension (00P3) and open-cover dimension (04MU); expanded by second reader K1

lean.statement:
theorem baseChange_dim {k k' : Type u} {C : Scheme.{u}} [Field k] [Field k']
    [Algebra k k'] [IsAlgClosed k] [IsAlgClosed k']
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] :
    topologicalKrullDim (pullback f
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k'))) : Scheme.{u}) =
      topologicalKrullDim C
